noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 5 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.727 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.750, Score minimum: 0.634

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. fliprate (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 12.87 vs bruit blanc 0.03
     - Hurst max: 1.119, Pente FFT: -1.019
  2. flip (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 12.87 vs bruit blanc 0.03
     - Hurst max: 1.119, Pente FFT: -1.019
  3. magnetization (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 18.67 vs bruit blanc 0.03
     - Hurst max: 0.843, Pente FFT: -0.672

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. magnetization (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.712
  2. localvar (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.817
  3. susceptibility (score: 0.634)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.925
